message.reasoning: St. James is already bid up to $350, well above its $180 list price, and while it would give me two-thirds of the orange monopoly, I'd still need NY Avenue from the bank to complete it. Gemini's bid seems purely defensive since they have no orange synergy. The real question is whether paying $351 or more is worth it when I'm already stretched thin with $823 total and still can't guarantee the full monopoly. I'm wrestling with whether $375 is worth spending on St. James when I still need NY to complete orange—if Gemini wins instead, my orange path dies permanently since I can't pry it away from them later. The real tension is between making a disciplined final bid to keep my options alive versus the risk of overpaying for an incomplete set, especially since Gemini has way more cash and seems willing to keep escalating just to block me. I need to lock in my bid at $375 as my hard ceiling—if Gemini pushes higher, I'll fold to preserve cash for actually building houses later. Even though they might go to $400+ just to block me, $375 is the disciplined line I'm committing to.
